text: Good kickoff. Reminder: do NOT cite the 'three deaths' number outside this group — preliminary only until the final RCA. Sandra/David, the compliance number is your first deliverable.
Manual SEP-1 abstraction is in: 62% all-or-none. EHR dashboard says 84%. They are NOT the same measure. Long email coming.
Huh. On the floor I'd have guessed we were around seventy percent, honestly. Somewhere between those two. Nurses 'feel' like we hit the bundle most of the time but not always.
Both numbers are real, they measure different things. 84% = order placed in the sepsis set. 62% = completed to CMS spec. I'll relabel the dashboard so people stop conflating them.
Sending a proposal to the group: 1-hour door-to-antibiotic for everyone we suspect. Speed first.
Pushing back formally (memo sent). 1h for shock yes. Blanket 1h for all suspected sepsis = overuse with no proven benefit in non-shock. Stratify.
Workshop landed on stratification — 1h shock / 3h non-shock. Marcus and Elena both can live with it. That's going in v2.
Heads up: VX-200 pumps are under voluntary recall as of yesterday. Interim backup-pump/manual plan for sepsis abx is live. VX-210 swaps by early May.
Escalation decided: charge-nurse pager, not a dedicated sepsis nurse. Couldn't fund 6 FTE under the freeze. Trade-off noted; revisit FY27.
Quality Committee approved Protocol v2.0. Effective May 1. Thank you all. Mortality claim stays OFF the table until we have a powered read.
